content.short: Tonkeeper is a non-custodial TON wallet with swaps, staking, NFTs, dapp access, and token support.
content.description: Tonkeeper is a self-custody wallet for The Open Network. Its site describes support for TON, USDT on TON and TRON, instant transactions, built-in swaps, staking, NFTs, and a dapp browser. It is one of the main TON-native wallets for everyday sending, receiving, and app interaction. Tonkeeper | Self-Custody TON wallet Signer for Tonkeeper FAQ Support Documentation Bug Bounty Blog GitHub Tonkeeper Tonkeeper is your very personal wallet. Tonkeeper fills a practical wallet role because users need safe account access before using TON apps, payments, swaps, or collectibles.
